svg.aria-label: Zoe Pentacube · pentomino regions and legal cube permutations
svg.title: Zoe Pentacube · pentomino regions and legal cube permutations

g.title: subtitle
g.text: Thirty pentomino home regions · 150 stickers · legal quarter turns

g.title: equation-cover
g.text: Exact cover: 6 faces x 25 cells = 30 pentominoes x 5 stickers = 150

g.title: equation-turn
g.text: Layer turn: T(p,n) = (R p, R n) · T^4 = I · inverse = T^3

g.title: equation-rho
g.text: rho = home stickers / 150 · kappa = recovered regions / 30

g.title: equation-bound
g.text: ceil(displaced / 44) is only a weak lower bound, not an optimal distance

g.title: scope
g.text: Every scramble uses legal moves. Replay checks the complete event chain.

g.title: boundary
g.text: A puzzle result is not an intelligence score. No autonomous moves or hardware claims.
